cases.source: declare function add(left: i32, right: i32): i32;
cases.expected: ordinary declaration creates no foreign authority
ordinary import cannot authenticate a C library

cases.source: function imported(left: i32, right: i32): i32 { return add(left, right); }
cases.expected: plain call cannot replace the explicit raw intrinsic
reserved intrinsic namespace cannot be shadowed
indirect or aliased intrinsic cannot carry raw authority
operation key must be the exact literal
ordered ABI argument count must match
Boolean cannot enter an i32 lane

cases.source: const out: FfiI32Out = Ffi.outI32(); return Ffi.readI32(out);
cases.expected: read lacks initialization by a dominating successful call
take lacks a successful acquisition and cannot escape the wrapper

cases.source: function escaped(bytes: Vec<i32>): FfiBytes { return Ffi.borrowBytes(bytes); }
cases.expected: loan cannot leave its creating wrapper
foreign token cannot cross a private function parameter
handle cannot enter the byte allocator release
consumed token rejects before the second C call

cases.source: export function failure(seed: i32): i32 { return Ffi.foreignError("fixture-c-v0@0/fixture_open", 1); }
cases.expected: initial C exports must be total scalar bodies without foreign calls or terminal failures

cases.source: export function copied(bytes: Vec<i32>): Vec<i32> { return bytes; }
cases.expected: private owned layout cannot become a C export carrier
